sloka: सुगृहीतमनुष्यश्च सुहृद्भिः सार्धमात्मवान् ।प्राप्तकालं नु मन्येऽहं राजानं वीतसाध्वसा ॥२-९-३५॥
transliteration: sugṛhītamanuṣyaśca suhṛdbhiḥ sārdhamātmavān ।prāptakālaṁ nu manye'haṁ rājānaṁ vītasādhvasā ॥2-9-35॥

translations.english: I think the proper time has come (to ask for the boons). Without fear refrain the king forcibly from his intention of installing Rama.
